hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: Each member is obtained from the latent univariate function F: G0002 = F evaluated at x, G0003 = F evaluated at y, and G0001 = first-order Newton divided difference of F at nodes x and y.
required_assumptions: x != y for the non-confluent quotient form; the confluent case is the limiting divided difference.
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: G0002 and G0003 are the two point evaluations of the same formal function symbol f, and G0001 is the first-order divided difference built from those evaluations over the nodes x and y. This is a structural finite-difference relationship, not a physical interpretation.
